learning_outcomes.text: Uses appropriate dimensions and units in solving mechanical problems.
Lists the definitions necessary to analyze mechanical systems.
Defines the type of motion and calculates the fundamental quantities related to motion.
Analyzes moving systems in detail using the appropriate coordinate system.
Defines and correctly calculates the fundamental quantities causing motion.
Establishes appropriate mathematical models to analyze structures with continuous mass distribution and finds solutions suitable for the distribution geometry.
Compares dynamic and/or energy methods to analyze motion.
Decomposes multi-particle systems into their components and writes the equations of motion defining each component.
Measures fundamental quantities experimentally, draws graphs, collects data, tabulates collected data, compares experimental and theoretical results.

syllabus_topics: Circular Motion and Other Applications of Newton's Laws
Rotation of a Rigid Body about a Fixed Axis
